definitions.explanation: Having superior capabilities or functionality. Used to describe machines, devices, materials, and other products that perform at a high level.

examples.japanese: {高性能|こうせいのう}なパソコンが{欲|ほ}しい。
この{高性能|こうせいのう}カメラは{暗|くら}い{場所|ばしょ}でもきれいに{撮|と}れる。
examples.english: This high-performance camera can take clear photos even in dark places.

examples.japanese: {高性能|こうせいのう}な{半導体|はんどうたい}の{開発|かいはつ}が{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Development of high-performance semiconductors is advancing around the world.

notes:
{高性能|こうせいのう} is composed of {高|こう} (high) + {性能|せいのう} (performance, capability).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高性能|こうせいのう}パソコン: high-performance PC
- {高性能|こうせいのう}エンジン: high-performance engine
- {高性能|こうせいのう}{半導体|はんどうたい}: high-performance semiconductor
- {高性能|こうせいのう}{素材|そざい}: high-performance material

RELATED WORDS:
- {低性能|ていせいのう}: low-performance
- {高機能|こうきのう}: high-functionality, feature-rich
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}: high-quality

USAGE: Used as a modifier with な or as a prefix directly before nouns. Common in product descriptions, technology articles, and advertising.
